bom_lines.spec: 42CrMo4 +QT / 1.7225 round bar, EN 10204 3.1 certificate, saw cut for shaft blank
bom_lines.basis: Scaled from PM-SH-1998 material EUR 10.4 for 42CrMo4 +QT Ø40 x 185 mm; target is same material, Ø40 x 180 mm, slightly shorter. Cross-checked against PM-SH-2214 material EUR 11.2 for larger Ø42 x 195 mm.

bom_lines.spec: Turn overall 180 mm shaft between centres, Ø40 m6 central diameter, shoulders/chamfers/radii, DIN 332-D M8 centre holes both ends
bom_lines.basis: Derived from PM-SH-2214 machining EUR 28.6 and PM-SH-1998 machining EUR 26.9; allocated turning share for same gear_shaft family, same IT6-class datum-bearing layout, similar length/diameter.

bom_lines.spec: DIN 5480 W30 x 1.5 x 18 spline, length 45 mm, hobbed/cut and inspected to DIN 5480
bom_lines.basis: Taken primarily from PM-SH-2214 because it has the same DIN 5480 W30 x 1.5 x 18 spline; supported by PM-SH-1998 W28 x 1.5 x 16 spline cost history.

bom_lines.spec: Mill/slot keyway 12 P9 x 5 with fit inspection
bom_lines.basis: Based on PM-SH-2214 and PM-SH-1998, both with 12 P9 keyway in same material and shaft family.

bom_lines.spec: Machine M20 x 1.5 external thread on right-end section, assumed 27 mm thread section pending drawing confirmation
bom_lines.basis: Added from PM-SH-2214, which includes M20 x 1.5 thread on comparable 42CrMo4 +QT gear shaft; PM-SH-1998 not used for this line because it has no thread.

bom_lines.spec: Induction harden spline section to 54-58 HRC, case depth 1.5-2.5 mm, with hardness/case-depth verification
bom_lines.basis: Averaged from PM-SH-2214 heat treatment EUR 7.4 and PM-SH-1998 EUR 7.0; both use induction hardening 54-58 HRC on comparable splined 42CrMo4 +QT shafts.

bom_lines.spec: Grind 2x Ø25 h6 bearing seats, Ra 0.4; hold runout 0.02 to datum A-B; demagnetize after grinding
bom_lines.basis: Interpolated between PM-SH-1998 grinding EUR 9.1 for 2x Ø25 h6 and PM-SH-2214 grinding EUR 9.8 for 2x Ø25 h6 on a slightly larger/longer shaft; includes demagnetizing as post-grind handling.

bom_lines.spec: Dimensional inspection of Ø25 h6 seats, Ø40 m6, spline, keyway, M20 thread gauge, runout to A-B, surface finish, hardness report, material certificate review
bom_lines.basis: Based on inspection burden embedded in PM-SH-2214 and PM-SH-1998 overhead/routing; increased slightly for explicit runout 0.02, Ra 0.4 and hardening documentation requirements.

bom_lines.spec: Shop overhead, fixture handling, internal logistics, protective oiling and packaging for ground bearing seats
bom_lines.basis: Scaled from PM-SH-1998 overhead EUR 10.4 and PM-SH-2214 overhead EUR 11.4; target complexity sits between those references.

raw_material.stock_size: Ø42 mm round bar, saw blank approx. 188 mm before facing and grinding allowance
raw_material.scrap_note: Gross weight estimated from Ø42 x 188 mm steel blank at 7.85 g/cm3. Net weight estimated from stepped Ø40/Ø30/Ø25 shaft geometry using PM-SH-1998 and PM-SH-2214 as comparable geometry anchors; expected machining/saw-loss scrap approx. 0.83 kg per pc, recyclable steel turnings.
